about: Reviewed defaults of discover_indicators (AQ-04A), moved out of the discovery code. They apply to tool discovery only: concept_search, the catalogue search and the UI never read this file. Rules name concepts, phrases and datasets that already exist; services/tools/discovery_policy.py validates them when loaded and against concepts.json and recipes.json, and a rule whose concept is absent is inert (it assumes nothing). `phrase` is put in front of the question and must be a specific alias of its concept. `terms` are the words by which a question names a definition itself (a trailing * is any ending); a definition named by one of its specific aliases counts too. A question that names a definition never gets a default. `population.cities.place_filter` lets one named county narrow a city ranking (REF_AREA = that county's exact label, applied by the shared tool before eligibility and top K); `except` lists county slugs that are never used as a filter because the name is also a city (Municipiul Bucuresti). Remove the key to report a county around a city ranking as not applied. `level_defaults` picks a definition by the level the question points at (county, region, national) when it names none itself; a level without an entry, a level that cannot be told, or `no_level: clarify` leaves the clarification. National unemployment is deliberately absent (owner, 2026-10-18): the ILO national series has no all-ages total cell and the national registered rate is not served, so a national default would give no single figure.
